purpose: IT-01 census: classify every integration-tests surface. Only suites wired to real containers/channels count as integration evidence; literal/simulated stub tests are marked scaffold and disabled, never counted as passes.

CONTAINER_GATED_REAL_INTEGRATION.meaning: extends AudioVideoContainerBase; IntegrationImagesCondition reports an honest skip when GH-90000 service images are absent

STUB_SCAFFOLD_DISABLED.meaning: literal-constant assertions, Map.of fixtures or simulated local calls with no real service/container/channel interaction; @Disabled until replaced by a wired suite — not evidence

perModuleIntegrationSurfaces.note: outside the integration-tests module; owned by their packages

guards.noTautologyAsIntegration: a test asserting only literals/Map.of fixtures/simulated locals may not carry an Integration/E2E/Load/Journey name without an explicit @Disabled scaffold reason
guards.honestSkip: container-gated suites skip via IntegrationImagesCondition with the missing image names — never silently pass
guards.crosswalkComplete: every *.java file in the integration-tests source tree is classified
